summary: Frontend visual verification of 13 new screens + 5 behavioral fixes in TallyDekho mock app. All core flows tested via Playwright browser automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: phone 9876543210, OTP 123456, then register screen (fill name + accept terms), then skip tally sync. All new screens verified working with correct data.
